veg.make_ahead: Stock up to 3 days ahead, or freeze

steps.text: Put the shiitake mushrooms, onion, carrots, ginger, garlic and spring onions in a large pot and cover with the water.
Simmer gently for 1 hour, then strain. Keep the shiitake mushrooms, trim off the stalks and slice the caps.
Season the stock with the soy sauce and white pepper. Cut the tofu into cubes and warm it in the stock for 5 minutes.
Cook the noodles and bok choy briefly, then pour the hot stock over them with the tofu and sliced shiitake. The secret is there isn't one.

veg.n: Valley of Peace kung pao tofu
veg.make_ahead: Press and cube the tofu up to 1 day ahead and mix the sauce up to 2 days ahead, both chilled; coat, fry and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Rinse the jasmine rice, then simmer covered in 450ml water on low for 15 minutes and rest off the heat.

Pat the tofu dry, toss with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and the 2 tbsp cornflour for the tofu. Mix the remaining 3 tbsp soy, the black vinegar, sugar, the cornflour for the sauce and 60ml water for the sauce.
Slice the garlic, grate the ginger and cut the spring onions into 3cm lengths.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot, stir-fry the dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns for 20 seconds, then add the tofu and fry for 5 to 6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spring onion, then the sauce, and toss until glossy. Stir in the peanuts and serve with the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Make the hush puppy batter up to 4 hours ahead and the slaw up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; roast the eggplant and fry on the night

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the cut sides deeply in a criss-cross and brush with the melted butter mixed with the Cajun seasoning.
Roast cut side up at 200C until soft right through and well browned.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg into a hush puppy batter.
Heat the oil to 180C and fry spoonfuls of batter until golden.
Shred the cabbage and mix with mayonnaise for slaw.
Serve the eggplant with lemon, hush puppies and slaw.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble and wrap the parcels up to 4 hours ahead and keep them chilled; cook on the night

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick slabs and the zucchini into long strips. Lay them on four sheets of foil with lemon slices, the sliced ginger and the coriander.
Dot with butter and wrap each parcel well in foil.
Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once.
Rest briefly before opening the parcels.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; batter, fry and sauce it on the night

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into bite-sized florets. Whisk the cornflour, plain flour and cold water into a batter and toss the florets through it.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Heat the oil and fry the cauliflower in batches until crisp and golden.
Warm the honey with the soy sauce until bubbling and toss the cauliflower through.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the cauliflower with butter and salt up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Trim the cauliflower leaves, rub all over with the butter and salt. Toss the apple, onion and kumara with the olive oil in a roasting tray.
Sit the cauliflower on the bed of apple, onion and kumara, cover with foil and roast at 200C.
Uncover and roast until the cauliflower is deep golden and a knife slides in easily.
Make gravy with the flour, vegetable stock and pan juices.

veg.n: Chef Didier's haloumi with orange sauce
veg.make_ahead: Serve straight away

steps.text: Par-boil the potatoes and cut into chunks. Cut the haloumi into 8 thick slabs and juice the oranges.
Fry the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the olive oil until crisp, then keep warm.
Sear the haloumi in the remaining oil for 2 minutes a side until golden, then set aside.
Add the orange juice, honey, orange liqueur and stock to the pan and reduce until glossy.
Whisk in the butter.
Steam the green beans and serve alongside.

veg_af.n: Chef Didier's haloumi with orange sauce (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Par-boil the potatoes and cut into chunks. Cut the haloumi into 8 thick slabs, juice all the oranges and zest the extra one.
Fry the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the olive oil until crisp, then keep warm.
Sear the haloumi in the remaining oil for 2 minutes a side until golden, then set aside.
Add the orange juice and zest, honey and stock to the pan and reduce until glossy.
Whisk in the butter.
Steam the green beans and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Make the onion and tomato topping up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; warm it through and simmer the hot dogs to serve

steps.text: Slice the onions and soften them in the oil.
Add the tomato paste and a splash of water and cook down.
Simmer the vegetarian hot dogs in water until heated through.
Warm the sauerkraut and steam the buns.
Fill the buns with the hot dogs, mustard, sauerkraut and onions.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the pineapple and capsicum and cube the tofu up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; coat and fry the tofu just before serving so it stays crisp

steps.text: Cut the pineapple and capsicum into chunks. Pat the tofu dry and toss in the beaten egg, then the cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in batches in the oil at 180C until crisp.
Simmer the pineapple and capsicum with the vinegar, sugar and tomato sauce, then thicken with a spoon of the leftover cornflour mixed with water.
Toss the tofu through and serve with the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms all over in the oil in a flameproof casserole.
Add the onion, carrots, stock, soy sauce and thyme.
Add the potatoes, cover and braise at 160C until everything is tender.
Lift out the vegetables, thicken the juices with the flour into gravy and serve family style.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the garlic yoghurt up to 2 days ahead, chilled; rub and roast the pumpkin on the night

steps.text: Rub the pumpkin with the cumin, 3 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt and lay in a roasting tray.
Roast covered at 200C for 20 minutes, then uncover, add the chickpeas and roast until the pumpkin is soft and charred at the edges.
Crush the last garlic clove and stir it through the yoghurt.
Pile the pumpkin and chickpeas on a board and serve with warm flatbread and garlic yoghurt.

veg.make_ahead: Filling a day ahead, top and bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil with the onions, then stir in the flour.
Add the brown ale, water, soy sauce and lentils and simmer until thick.
Pour into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk. Cook the peas and serve everything together.

veg_af.make_ahead: Filling a day ahead, top and bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil with the onions, then stir in the flour.
Add the mushroom stock, malt vinegar, water, soy sauce and lentils and simmer until thick.
Pour into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk. Cook the peas and serve everything together.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the goulash up to 2 days ahead and reheat gently; boil the noodles fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onions slowly in the same pot until soft.
Stir in the paprika and caraway, then add the tomatoes, stock, capsicum, butter beans and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer gently until thick and rich.
Boil the noodles and toss with butter.
Serve over the noodles with sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Chop the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep them in cold water in the fridge; drain, dry well and roast with the mushrooms on the night

steps.text: Chop the potatoes into a roasting tray, toss with the oil and salt and roast at 220C.

After 30 minutes, push the potatoes aside, add the mushrooms cap side down, dot with the butter, season with salt and scatter with half the thyme. Roast at 200C until the mushrooms are tender and the potatoes crisp.
Make gravy in a pan with the mushroom juices from the tray, flour, the rest of the thyme and the stock. Tear the mushrooms apart at the table.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce and meatballs up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: tins brown lentils (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Soak the bread in a little water and squeeze it out. Mash the lentils roughly and mix with the bread, mushrooms, egg, half the cheese and the chopped parsley.
Roll into big balls and brown all over in the remaining oil.
Simmer gently in the tomatoes with basil, turning the meatballs carefully once.
Cook the spaghetti.
Pile over the pasta and top with the rest of the cheese.

veg.make_ahead: Brown and simmer the tofu and chickpeas up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; reheat, then cook the rice and peas fresh

steps.text: Brown the tofu in the oil, then add the diced onion and the peeled garlic cloves.
Pour in the vegetable stock, add the chickpeas, cover and simmer 15 minutes until the garlic is soft.
Cook the long grain rice, stir through the butter and the peas.
Plate in tidy single portions, like the airline trays.

veg.n: Lost Boys roast haloumi, potatoes and corn
veg.make_ahead: Toss the haloumi in the garlic mix up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast and grill on the night

steps.text: Mix the crushed garlic, lemon zest, paprika and oil. Chop the potatoes and toss in half of it.
Roast the potatoes at 220C.
Toss the haloumi in the rest of the garlic mix, add to the tray and roast until golden.
Grill the corn cobs, turning until charred.
Pile it all in the middle with a squeeze of the lemon and eat with your hands. Bangarang.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; make the white sauce, assemble and bake on the day

ingredients.item: tins brown lentils (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until browned, add the lentils and passata and simmer.
Make a white sauce from the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the lentil sauce, lasagne sheets and white sauce in a baking dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C until golden and bubbling.

veg.make_ahead: Cut and steam the cauliflower steaks up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; crumb, fry and make the gravy on the night

ingredients.item: plain flour, seasoned, for the coating

steps.text: Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower and steam for 5 minutes, then cool.
Dredge in seasoned flour, dip in buttermilk, then flour again.
Shallow-fry 4 minutes a side until crisp.
Pour off most of the oil, stir the gravy flour into the pan, whisk in the milk and simmer thick with lots of black pepper.
Serve over the mashed potato.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: tins brown lentils (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Slice the carrots and leeks and cut the potatoes into chunks.
Soften the leeks and carrots in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the barley, potatoes, rosemary and stock.
Simmer until the barley is tender, adding the lentils for the last 10 minutes.
Season and serve in deep bowls with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and marinate in the lemon juice, oregano and oil while the oven heats.
Roast the capsicums at 220C until soft and blistered, then peel and slice into strips.
Cook the rice. Grill the tofu until golden on both sides.
Build bowls of rice with the tofu, capsicum, cucumber and feta and drizzle with tahini.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; slice the mushrooms and halve the tomatoes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge

steps.text: Fry the vegetarian sausages in the oil until browned.
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes to the pan. Once the mushrooms are browned, stir through the smoked paprika and soy sauce.
Fry the eggs in a little of the butter at the end.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Plate it all up.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Mix the plant-based mince with the cheese, parsley, breadcrumbs and egg. Roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs on top.

veg.n: Fourth of July sticky barbecue eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Bake the eggplant up to 1 day ahead in the fridge, and make the potato salad up to 1 day ahead; brush with sauce, grill and cook the corn on the day

steps.text: Cut the eggplants lengthways into thick wedges, rub with the salt and oil.
Bake covered at 200C until soft.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.
Boil the potatoes, cool and dress with mayonnaise and spring onion.
Grill the corn and serve it all picnic style.

veg.n: Mike and Marcus swap Cuban sandwich (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the orange and lime juice, crushed garlic, oregano, cumin, salt and oil.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Spread on a lined tray and roast at 200C until browned and juicy.
Thinly slice the smoked tofu.
Split the rolls, spread with mustard and fill with the mushrooms, smoked tofu, Swiss cheese and pickles.
Butter the outsides and press in a hot sandwich press until crisp and the filling is piping hot.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Cut three deep slashes on each side of the eggplants, leaving the stems on.
Stuff the slashes with lemon slices, parsley and sliced garlic, then rub with oil and salt.
Grill or bake at 220C until the eggplants collapse and are soft right through.
Serve whole, stems on.

veg.n: Hibachi tofu and mushroom fried rice
veg.make_ahead: Cook and chill the rice the day before; sear the tofu and mushrooms and fry the rice on the night

steps.text: Cook the rice the day before.
Sear the sliced tofu and mushrooms on a smoking plate with the garlic butter made from half the butter and the crushed garlic, and half the soy.
Add sliced zucchini and onion.
Fry the rice with the eggs, remaining butter and soy alongside, and serve everything together.

veg.n: Great Hall honey haloumi and Yorkshires
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the potatoes in the olive oil and roast until golden.
Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a batter and rest.
Heat the vegetable oil in muffin tins, pour in the batter and bake until puffed.
Mix the honey and mustard, coat the haloumi and roast on a lined tray for the last 10 minutes until golden and sticky.
Cook the peas with the butter and warm the gravy.
Serve everything together.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the capsicum and onion up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; grill the vegetarian sausages and toast the rolls fresh

steps.text: Slice the red capsicums and the onions and cook in most of the oil over medium-high heat for 12 minutes until soft and charred.
Brush the vegetarian sausages with the rest of the oil, roll in the lightly crushed fennel seeds and grill on a medium barbecue for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned.
Split the long rolls, toast, and lay a slice of provolone in.
Add a sausage, the capsicum and onion and a spoon of chopped hot giardiniera.

veg.make_ahead: Make the plant-based meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; spread the baguette with the garlic butter up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Roll the plant-based mince into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer.
Split the baguette and spread with the butter mixed with the garlic.
Bake the bread until crisp.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Toss the sauce through the spaghetti with the cheese and serve with the bread.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms in the oil and roast cut side up at 200C in a baking dish.
Boil the potatoes. Steam the beans.
Simmer the cream with Dijon until thick and stir in the cheese.
Spoon over the mushrooms and grill until bubbling.
Toss the potatoes in butter and serve with the beans.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and halve the tomatoes up to 1 day ahead; fry and toss through the spaghetti on the night

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti.
Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until browned, then add the garlic and chilli.
Add the wine, tomatoes and nori and simmer until the wine reduces by half.
Toss through the spaghetti and parsley.

veg_af.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms, halve the tomatoes and crumble the nori up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; cook the sauce and spaghetti fresh

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti.
Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until browned, then add the garlic and chilli.
Add the stock, lemon juice, tomatoes and nori and simmer until reduced by half.
Toss through the spaghetti and parsley.

veg.n: Clemenza's Sunday sauce with mushroom meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Sauce is better made 1 day ahead, keeps 3 days chilled. Add the meatballs on the day

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the olive oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the ricotta, egg, breadcrumbs, a share of the cheese and the salt. Form 12 meatballs and chill.
Brown the meatballs gently in the rest of the oil with the sausages cut into chunks, then set aside.
Soften the onion in the same pot, add the garlic and tomato paste, then stir in the tomatoes and water. Cover partly and simmer gently for 45 minutes, stirring and adding water if needed.
Return the meatballs and sausages and simmer for 15 minutes without stirring hard.
Boil the rigatoni, toss with the sauce and serve with the meatballs and the rest of the cheese.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Season the mushrooms with salt, then brown them in the oil, and set aside.
Soften the sliced onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the wine, tomatoes, rosemary, beans and mushrooms, cover and braise at 160C.
Cook the polenta in the salted water, stir in the butter.
Serve the mushrooms and beans on top of the polenta.
Season the mushrooms with salt, then brown them in the oil, and set aside.
Soften the sliced onion and garlic in the same pan.
Add the stock, vinegar, tomatoes, rosemary, beans and mushrooms, cover and braise at 160C.
Cook the polenta in the salted water, stir in the butter.
Serve the mushrooms and beans on top of the polenta.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead; stretch the dough, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Stretch the dough thin on a floured tray.
Spread with sauce and scatter with mozzarella, plant-based pepperoni and mushrooms.
Bake on a hot steel or tray at the highest oven heat.
Slice and leave in a box on the bench.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

ingredients.item: tins hearts of palm (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Shred the hearts of palm with a fork and roughly mash the chickpeas. Mix with the egg, nori, mayonnaise, Dijon, sliced spring onion and breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes.
Chill for at least 30 minutes.
Pan fry in the oil until golden on both sides.
Serve with lemon and a green salad.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; cook the sauce and pasta on the night

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms into thick coins, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Sear the mushrooms in the olive oil until golden, then add the garlic and chilli.
Add the tomatoes and stock and cook until the tomatoes soften.
Toss through the spaghetti with the parsley.

veg.n: Angel of Verdun mushrooms, cider and cream
veg.make_ahead: Brown the mushrooms and simmer them with the beans and cider up to 1 day ahead; reheat and stir in the cream to serve

steps.text: Season the mushrooms.
Brown in the butter in batches over high heat, then set aside.
Soften the eschalots in the pan.
Pour in the cider and scrape up the browned bits.
Return the mushrooms, add the beans and simmer until the cider reduces by half.
Stir in the cream and simmer until glossy.
Scatter with parsley and serve with a warm baguette.

veg_af.n: Angel of Verdun mushrooms, cider and cream (alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Cook the mushrooms and beans in the apple juice and vinegar up to 1 day ahead and reheat gently; add the cream just before serving

steps.text: Season the mushrooms.
Brown in the butter in batches over high heat, then set aside.
Soften the eschalots in the pan.
Pour in the apple juice and vinegar and scrape up the browned bits.
Return the mushrooms, add the beans and simmer until the liquid reduces by half.
Stir in the cream and simmer until glossy.
Scatter with parsley and serve with a warm baguette.

veg.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead and keep them in cold water in the fridge, dried well before frying; cook the mushrooms and sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips.
Fry twice until crisp.
Brush the mushrooms with the olive oil and grill for 4 minutes a side until tender.
In the pan, toast the peppercorns, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve with the chips and a green salad.

veg.make_ahead: Curry up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin, the remaining coconut milk, bruised lemongrass, torn lime leaves, soy sauce and palm sugar.
Simmer gently until the pumpkin is tender, adding the tofu for the last 5 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Needs 24 hours marinating, keeps 4 days chilled

ingredients.item: caster sugar, 30g for the cure and the rest for the sauce

steps.text: Bury the whole carrots in the rock salt in a baking dish and bake at 190C until tender.
Crack off the salt, peel the carrots and slice into long thin ribbons with a peeler.
Toss the ribbons with 2 tbsp of the oil, 1 tbsp of the vinegar, 30g of the sugar, half the chopped dill and the white pepper. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 24 hours.
Mix the Dijon, remaining sugar, vinegar, oil and dill for the sauce. Serve with rye bread.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the cauliflower and cut the vegetables up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; roast and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Rub the cauliflower with 2 tbsp of the oil, lemon zest, crushed garlic and chopped rosemary.
Cut the potatoes and carrots, toss with the remaining oil and put them in the tray around the cauliflower.
Roast at 200C until the cauliflower is golden and tender to the centre.
Rest the cauliflower.
Make a quick gravy from the tray juices with flour, the stock and a squeeze of lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked fresh and served hot; the mushrooms can be sliced up to 1 day ahead in the fridge

steps.text: Grill the vegetarian sausages.
Grill the halved tomatoes alongside and warm the beans.
Fry the sliced mushrooms in the oil until crisp at the edges and stir through the smoked paprika. Fry the haloumi, then the eggs.
Toast the white bread, spread with the butter and serve everything together.

veg.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Put the peas, smoked paprika, onion, carrots, celery, stock and water in a large pot.
Simmer for 1.5 hours, stirring now and then, until the peas break down.
Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp and stir it through. Season.
Serve with crusty bread. Eat it, don't throw it.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the miso glaze up to 3 days ahead; roast the eggplant until soft up to 3 hours ahead, then glaze and finish in the oven before serving

steps.text: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh, brush with the oil and roast cut side up at 220C.
Mix the miso, honey and soy.
Cook the rice until tender.
Brush the miso glaze over the eggplant and roast for 8 minutes more until bubbling.
Char the broccolini in a hot pan and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the celeriac up to 1 day ahead and keep it in the fridge; mix the horseradish cream up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Peel the celeriacs and rub with the garlic, pepper, 2 tbsp of the oil and the salt.
Roast at 200C wrapped in foil for 60 minutes, then unwrap and roast until golden and tender, then rest and slice.
Parboil the potatoes, rough up, toss in the remaining oil and roast.
Simmer the tray juices with the wine and stock until reduced by half.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.

veg_af.make_ahead: Rub the celeriac up to 1 day ahead and keep it in the fridge; mix the horseradish cream up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Peel the celeriacs and rub with the garlic, pepper, 2 tbsp of the oil and the salt.
Roast at 200C wrapped in foil for 60 minutes, then unwrap and roast until golden and tender, then rest and slice.
Parboil the potatoes, rough up, toss in the remaining oil and roast.
Simmer the tray juices with all the stock and the vinegar until reduced by half.
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and a squeeze of lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; cut the cauliflower steaks and crush the garlic up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Bake the frozen chips following the packet.
Cut two thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, season and sear in the oil in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side, then baste with the butter and the crushed garlic cloves.
Finish in the oven at 200C until tender.
Serve with the oven fries and the spinach wilted with the cream.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce best made just before serving

steps.text: Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon to a few spoonfuls.
Whisk with the yolks over low heat and drizzle in 200g of the warm clarified butter for the béarnaise.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, sear 4 minutes a side, then rest.
Brush the haloumi with garlic butter made from the garlic and the remaining butter.
Grill the haloumi until golden on both sides.
Plate the mushroom steak with the haloumi and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Dough can be made a day ahead

steps.text: Rest the dough at room temperature for an hour. Season the tomatoes with salt.
Stretch the bases thin and spread with the sauce. Top with the mozzarella and plant-based pepperoni.
Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until bubbling and charred in spots. Sprinkle with oregano and cut big.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in a hot pan with oil.
Cook the onions slowly in the same pot until soft.
Stir in the sweet paprika, hot paprika and caraway, then add the tomatoes, stock, potatoes, capsicum and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer gently until the potatoes are very tender and the sauce is thick.
Boil the noodles and serve the goulash over them with the sour cream.

veg.n: Smoky mushrooms and scrambled eggs on toast
veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until crisp at the edges, then stir through the smoked paprika and soy sauce.
Whisk the eggs with salt and scramble slowly in butter until soft.
Toast and butter the bread.
Serve on tin plates with the mushrooms and chives scattered over the eggs.

veg.make_ahead: Score and rub the pumpkin up to 1 day ahead and keep covered in the fridge; mix the panko topping up to 1 day ahead. Roast and steam the broccolini on the night

ingredients.item: small butternut pumpkins, halved lengthways and seeded

steps.text: Score the pumpkin flesh in a criss-cross and rub with half the oil and the salt.
Roast cut side up at 200C with the potatoes and apples tossed in the rest of the oil.
Mix the panko with the chopped sage and melted butter, press onto the pumpkin and roast until the crust is crisp.
Steam the broccolini and serve on a long platter.

veg.n: Ludlow baked beans with brown bread (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Soak overnight, bean dish keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight in cold water, then drain.
Put the beans, smoked paprika, soy sauce, onion, molasses, sugar, mustard and water in a covered dish.
Bake at 150C for 4 hours, stirring in the smoked tofu for the last hour.
Spread the brown bread with the butter and serve with the beans and coleslaw.

veg.make_ahead: Soften the onion and capsicum up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; add the rice and bake on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil in an ovenproof pan.
Add the rice, saffron, paprika and stock and stir in the chickpeas and artichokes.
Cover and bake at 180C.
Stir through the peas and olives.

veg.make_ahead: Make the base and brown the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, kept chilled; reheat, add the beans and tofu and serve

steps.text: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in 2 tbsp of the oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine, stock and nori and simmer for 20 minutes.
Brown the mushrooms in the remaining oil in a separate pan and add to the pot with the beans.
Add the tofu and simmer gently until heated through. Serve with sourdough.

veg_af.make_ahead: Simmer the tomato and stock base up to 2 days ahead, covered in the fridge; reheat with the mushrooms, beans and tofu on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion, fennel and garlic in 2 tbsp of the oil.
Add the tomatoes, all the stock, the lemon juice and nori and simmer for 20 minutes.
Brown the mushrooms in the remaining oil in a separate pan and add to the pot with the beans.
Add the tofu and simmer gently until heated through. Serve with sourdough.

veg.make_ahead: Shape the roast up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, then cool and mix with the chestnuts, walnuts, lentils, breadcrumbs, eggs and half the salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin and bake at 180C until firm and browned.
Halve the potatoes, toss in the remaining oil and salt and roast at 200C alongside the roast for 45 minutes.
Shred the cabbage and slice the apples, then braise together with the vinegar and a splash of water for 45 minutes until soft.
Rest the roast for 10 minutes, then turn out and slice.

veg.make_ahead: Make the beans up to 2 days ahead in the fridge and reheat; dress the slaw up to 3 hours ahead; grill the haloumi and sausages to order

steps.text: Simmer the baked beans with the onion and molasses.
Shred the cabbage and toss with the mayonnaise and vinegar.
Brush the haloumi and vegetarian sausages with the oil and grill over hot coals.
Slice the sausages and haloumi to share.

veg.n: Dinner-in-the-dark red wine lentils with mash
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots and celery.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the onion, carrots, celery and garlic and cook.
Add the wine, crushed tomatoes, stock, lentils, rosemary and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Spoon the lentils over the mash.

veg_af.n: Dinner-in-the-dark red wine lentils with mash (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Dice the onion, carrots and celery.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the onion, carrots, celery and garlic and cook.
Add all the stock, the vinegar, crushed tomatoes, lentils, rosemary and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Spoon the lentils over the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, pibil reheats well

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (565 g each), drained

steps.text: Blend the achiote paste with the oil and the orange and two limes' juice. Squeeze the jackfruit dry, break it up and toss with the mushrooms and the paste.
Wrap in banana leaves in a baking dish.
Roast covered at 180C until soft and deeply coloured.
Pickle the onion in the last lime's juice while it cooks.
Shred the jackfruit with two forks and serve in warm tortillas with the pickled onion.

veg.make_ahead: Trim and press the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, chilled; flour, fry and make the gravy on the night

steps.text: Remove the mushroom stalks, press the caps flat with a plate and season the flour.
Dip in seasoned flour, then egg, then flour again.
Shallow fry in about 1cm oil until golden each side.
For the gravy, cook a spoon of the leftover flour in a little of the oil, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick. Season with lots of pepper.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushrooms up to 2 days ahead, reheat in the sauce

steps.text: Shred the mushrooms lengthways with a fork and toss with the oil, paprika, brown sugar, garlic and salt.
Roast on a lined tray at 200C, turning once, until browned and crisp at the edges.
Simmer the tomato sauce with the vinegar until slightly thick.
Toss the mushrooms through the sauce. Toss the cabbage with mayonnaise for slaw and serve with white bread. The secret's in the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the glaze up to 3 days ahead and boil the eggs up to 1 day ahead; fry the tofu and cook the rice on the night

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, in thick slices

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Cook the sushi rice.
Pat the tofu dry and fry in the oil until golden, then brush with the glaze until sticky.
Soft boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Slice the cucumber thinly and dress in rice vinegar.
Pack boxes with rice, tofu, pickled ginger, cucumber and egg.

veg_af.make_ahead: Simmer the apple juice glaze up to 3 days ahead and boil the eggs up to 1 day ahead; fry the tofu and cook the rice on the night

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, in thick slices

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice and sugar until syrupy.
Cook the sushi rice.
Pat the tofu dry and fry in the oil until golden, then brush with the glaze until sticky.
Soft boil the eggs, peel and halve.
Slice the cucumber thinly and dress in rice vinegar.
Pack boxes with rice, tofu, pickled ginger, cucumber and egg.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer the relish up to 3 days ahead and keep chilled; brush and grill the sausages on the night

steps.text: Slice the onions, chop the tomatoes and chilli.
Simmer with the sugar into a relish.
Brush the vegetarian sausages with the oil mixed with the coriander and nutmeg, then grill over coals or a hot grill, turning, until browned.
Serve two sausages in each roll with relish.

veg.n: Creamy tarragon mushrooms and butter beans
veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom and butter bean sauce up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; reheat it, then mash the potatoes and steam the beans fresh

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, thickly slice the mushrooms and chop the tarragon.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches until golden.
Pour in the wine, add the butter beans and simmer until reduced by half.
Stir in the cream and tarragon.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and steam the beans.

veg_af.n: Creamy tarragon mushrooms and butter beans (alcohol-free)
veg_af.make_ahead: Cook the mushrooms and butter beans in the stock and vinegar up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; reheat gently, then mash the potatoes and steam the beans fresh

steps.text: Peel the potatoes, thickly slice the mushrooms and chop the tarragon.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches until golden.
Pour in the stock and vinegar, add the butter beans and simmer until reduced by half.
Stir in the cream and tarragon.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and steam the beans.

veg.n: Dr Gordon's lentil loaf roast dinner
veg.make_ahead: Shape the loaf up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: tins brown lentils (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry. Mash the lentils roughly and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs, lemon zest and thyme leaves.
Press into a lined loaf tin, brush the top with the butter and bake at 180C for 50 minutes with the potatoes tossed in the remaining oil alongside.
Rest the loaf and make gravy from the flour, stock and a squeeze of lemon.
Steam the beans and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Score the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; salt, sear and baste on the night

ingredients.item: large king brown mushrooms, halved lengthways

steps.text: Score the cut side of the mushrooms in a criss-cross, pat dry and season with salt.
Heat a heavy pan with oil until hot and sear the mushrooms hard, cut side down first, then turn, in batches.
Lower the heat, add the butter, thyme and crushed garlic and baste for 2 to 3 minutes.
Rest briefly, slice and spoon over the pan butter.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the tofu in the peri peri sauce up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; grill and cook the rice on the night

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, in thick slices

steps.text: Blitz the chillies, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, oil and salt into a peri peri sauce.
Pat the tofu dry and marinate in the sauce.
Grill until charred on both sides.
Cook the rice with the turmeric.
Serve together.

veg.n: Winston the ogre's mushroom and barley stew
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots and toss the mushrooms in flour.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in oil.
Add the onion, carrots and garlic and cook.
Add the tomato paste, soy sauce, stock, barley and bay leaves and simmer covered until the barley is tender, adding the butter beans for the last 10 minutes.
Mash the butter with horseradish cream.
Serve with the horseradish butter and a crusty loaf.
